subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair or adopt the open external Feishu candidate, or start a fresh same-repository fix for the reply @mention false-negative?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository PR is closed and the only open candidate is a conflicting external fork with known review concerns that require ownership judgment before another repair lane starts.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the mention-gating and routing concerns with inspectable proof.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.
